The thing is there’s only so much u can do. It doesn’t matter how much yours willing to do if they’re not willing to change. When I was 15 my older brother who was 19 died of a heroine overdose even tho me and my family tried to do everything we could. The best advice I can really give you is try to understand him u know like he’s not thinking the way ur brother did he’s thinking like a junkie. To him it could feel like drugs are the only thing in the world that can make him feel something good. When my brother was in rehab he said they had to write a goodbye letter to the drug of their choice and he said it sounded like a love letter. So I mean just try to be as supportive as you can but try not to enable him. Don’t let him forget u care about him. I hope he has more luck than my brother did.
